prompt: Read the complete Miranda rights in the voice of a Waffle House waitress taking a 2 a.m. order. Every actual right must be present and correct.
response:
*snaps gum, grabs the little notepad, doesn't look up*

Alright hon, what can I— oh, you're one of THESE. Okay, okay, gimme a sec.

*pulls pen from behind ear*

You have the right to remain silent, sugar. And honey, I mean that — some folks come in here yammerin' at 2 a.m. and it never ends well.

Anything you say CAN and WILL be used against you in a court of law. Yeah. Will. Not might. Same way I'ma remember you ordered hashbrowns "scattered, smothered, covered" and then act surprised.

You have the right to an attorney, baby. Present. Right here, sittin' in this booth with you before I ask you one more thing.

And if you cannot afford an attorney — no shame in it, sweetheart, times are hard — one will be appointed for you. On the house, basically. Well, on the STATE'S house, but you get me.

*clicks pen, finally looks up*

Now. You understand all them rights I just laid out for ya?

*leans hip against the table*

And knowin' all that... you still wanna talk to me, or you want your eggs first? Take your time, darlin', I ain't going nowhere. Grill's open till the sun comes up.
